title: Coyame lights around mountain peaks
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Coyame lights around mountain peaks, about decades at Mexico (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Locals constantly talk about colored lights that wink in and out around the mountain peaks.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that people living near Coyame, a town in the Chihuahua region of northern Mexico, often talk about coloured lights that blink on and off around the mountain peaks. He draws on a book called Mexico's Roswell by Noe Torres and Ruben Uriarte, whose title compares the area to the famous Roswell UFO story in New Mexico. He tells it as a sign that something unusual keeps appearing in that area.
